title: Hangfire setup with quote-expiry and lead-inactivity-expiry jobs
objective: Hangfire runs on PostgreSQL with a secured dashboard; the only automatic status changes in the product — quote expiry and lead inactivity expiry — execute hourly per tenant rules with full history/audit (spec FR-42, §8, PRD 10.4 Expire rows).
implementation_details: AddHangfire with PostgreSqlStorage (connection from Vault config); AddHangfireServer; dashboard at /hangfire behind authorization filter requiring PermissionCatalog.Global.ViewAnyTenant

Jobs/QuoteExpiryJob.cs: per active tenant (explicit tenant loop with cross-tenant context): quotes in canonical sent/revised with valid_until < today -> status Expired via QuoteOperationExecutor system path (acting user = system), history row operation 'expire_automatic'; when tenant rule (future setting, default off) and lead has no other open quote -> lead Expired too (PRD 10.4)
Jobs/LeadInactivityExpiryJob.cs: open-category leads with last_activity_at < now - lead_inactivity_expiry_days -> lead Expired + history; quote activity already counts via T-022 stamping
System actor: audit rows with actor_user_id null and actor_label 'system'; RecurringJob.AddOrUpdate hourly cron for both; per-tenant counts logged (spec §15)
JobActivator scoping: each job iteration creates a DI scope and sets TenantContext explicitly per tenant

findings.description: QuoteExpiryJob.TryCascadeLeadExpiryAsync (the optional per-tenant ExpireLeadWhenLastQuoteExpires rule from implementation_details/PRD 10.4: when the rule is on and the expired quote's lead has no other open quote, the lead is also expired) has zero test coverage. Every test runs with the rule at its default-off value, so the entire cascade branch -- including the 'other open quote blocks cascade' guard via ListOtherOpenQuotesAsync and the LeadOperationExecutor.Expire cascade -- is never executed. The 6 agreed test_plan tests do not include a cascade case, so this is not an Implementor deviation from the plan, but the in-scope behavior remains unverified.
findings.evidence: QuoteExpiryJob.cs lines 110-145; ExpiryJobTests.cs seeds TenantSettings with C# defaults (ExpireLeadWhenLastQuoteExpires=false) and never sets it true.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one integration test: rule on, a Sent quote past valid_until whose lead has no other open quote -> lead becomes Expired with system-actor history/audit; plus a guard case with a sibling open quote asserting the lead is NOT expired.

findings.description: The quote-expiry candidate query (QuoteStore.ListExpiredCandidatesAsync) expires both canonical Sent and Revised quotes, but the positive expiry test only exercises a Sent quote. The Revised-past-valid_until path is asserted only indirectly (it is in the same canonical-key array). A Revised-specific positive assertion would fully cover FR-38's revised-quote expiry.
findings.evidence: QuoteStore.cs line 188 (expirableCanonicalKeys = Sent, Revised); ExpiryJobTests.cs test 1 seeds only a Sent quote.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend QuoteExpiryJob_WhenSentQuotePastValidUntil_ShouldExpireWithHistoryAndAudit (or add a sibling) to also seed a Revised quote past valid_until and assert it expires.
